meta.method: Compiled from dated news, UN and analyst sources (August–October 2026 where available). Every place cites at least one source; confidence reflects sourcing. Locality-level claims after August 2026 rely heavily on Critical Threats' weekly Congo War Security Review, which relays unverified claims from both sides; treat contested entries as fluid.
caveats: Front lines move faster than reporting; check each place's as_of date.
'Contested' means recent reports of fighting for control, not a confirmed change.
Activity zones mark armed-group attacks, not territorial control.
Unshaded areas have no reported change and remain under government administration.
